name: Oman

flag.description: A vertical red band at the hoist and a horizontal red band across the middle, with white above and green below on the fly side; the white national emblem of a khanjar dagger over two crossed swords sits in the upper hoist.
flag.symbolism: White represents peace and prosperity, red the battles against invaders, and green the fertility of the land; the khanjar and swords are traditional symbols of the nation.

hook: Oman has a red band like a sideways "T" splitting white from green, with a curved khanjar dagger and crossed swords in the top-left corner.
trivia: Before 1970 Oman used a plain red flag.
The khanjar dagger also appears on Omani banknotes and is still worn on formal occasions.
